profile.headline: Software Engineer at Remitly
profile.summary: I enjoy working with computers and learning new things, which is the main reasons I decided to pursue software engineering. I love learning new technologies, and want to work in an environment where I will always be learning new skills and further development my existing skill set.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: Developing the experimentation platform at Remitly to aid other developer teams and analysts in making informed business decisions.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: Software Development Engineer working on the ReCommerce Pricing, Listing, and Shopping Experience team to bring used and renewed items to customers at affordable prices by designing and implementing event-driven microservices using Java and AWS

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Software Development Engineer working on the ReCommerce Pricing, Listing, and Shopping Experience team to bring used and renewed items to customers at affordable prices by designing and implementing event-driven microservices using Java and AWS

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
I worked on both the Amazon Flex Platform and Payments teams during this time.

While working on the Payments team, I worked on backend Java services which interacted with multiple downstream accounting and payment processing dependencies in order to promptly and accurately pay Amazon Flex Drivers.

On the Flex Platform team I worked on Java backend services that powered the rest of the Amazon Flex ecosystem, such as identity management, authorization, and regional service area storage.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer Internship
positions.description: While working at Thomson Reuters I was on a team of interns writing tests in C# using the Selenium webdriver to increase coverage of Firm Central, a firm management solution. We exceeded our goal of 500 tests written by the end of the summer.

honors.title: Cum Laude
honors.issuer: Issued by Waunakee Community High School · Jun 2013

honors.title: SkillsUSA Wisconsin State Competition Engineering Challenge 3rd Place
honors.description: Our group was awarded 3rd place for our work on our Engineering Design and Development project.

projects.title: Solipstry Character Creator
projects.description: Character Builder for custom RPG system created by Alex Rinehart. Using the character builder, users can view talents, abilities, and skills without referencing the Solipstry book, enabling them to create a character without any reference material. The user can assign values to their character's attributes and skills, and export a character sheet as a PDF when they are finished.

projects.title: Board'Em
projects.description: Board'Em is a matchmaking app for board games. Users are able to create their own events or search for events near them. Users are able to leave comments, such as asking guests to bring snacks or to comment on what types of games they want to play.
